maker.name: Gateron
maker.about: Gateron Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. designs and produces micro switches and mechanical keyboard switches, including mechanical, optical and magnetic switches, with in-house mold making. It is based in Huizhou, Guangdong, and also makes switches for other keyboard brands.
